en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a lakeside town with railway tracks and industrial buildings in the foreground, a bus and some houses near the station area, and a hillside densely built with houses across the water. The lake dominates the center and right of the image under a sky filled with large clouds. Swedish text is printed along the bottom identifying the view and the publisher.
